safe.label: Everyone I held onto ended up going away
safe.note: The stated grief of the song: friends, lovers, a whole generation, gone before me.

safe.label: I look at what I became and see a stranger
safe.note: The man in the frame, the voice on the record, the face in the mirror — none of them line up.

safe.label: Given the chance to start over I would keep myself
safe.note: The one hopeful clause in the song, offered as a conditional that will not be granted.

safe.label: Pain is the last feeling that still reaches me
safe.note: Sensation as proof of life. The body has gone quiet everywhere else.

real.label: They did not leave me, I picked the drug over each of them
real.note: Reframes the loss as a series of choices he made at specific moments, not weather that happened to him.

real.label: I go looking for the hurt because numbness frightens me worse
real.note: The needle stopped working years ago; what is left is pressing on old damage to confirm he is still in the room.

safe.label: Everything I built turned out to be an empire of dirt
safe.note: A lifetime of work, and the estimate of its worth arrives late and low.

real.label: The legend kept growing while the man behind it quit showing up
real.note: People still stand for the songs, and he knows which years he was too far gone to have earned them.

links.source: Everyone I held onto ended up going away
links.target: They did not leave me, I picked the drug over each of them
links.rationale: The safe version has people vanishing on their own; the real version puts him at the door choosing. It moves from LOVE to FITNESS because the departures were consequences of what he was doing to his own body.

links.source: Pain is the last feeling that still reaches me
links.target: I go looking for the hurt because numbness frightens me worse
links.rationale: Pain is not just what still reaches him, it is what he actively seeks out, and the reason is fear of feeling nothing rather than devotion to feeling something.

links.source: Everything I built turned out to be an empire of dirt
links.target: The legend kept growing while the man behind it quit showing up
links.rationale: Names which part of the empire is dirt: not the work itself but the gap between the reputation and the years he was absent from it.

links.source: Given the chance to start over I would keep myself
links.target: The legend kept growing while the man behind it quit showing up
links.rationale: Wanting to keep himself only means anything if there is a self worth keeping underneath the reputation — which is exactly what r3 puts in doubt.
